title: Hold a licence to take water
what: Take water from a place only under a licence to take water from that place.

sources.title: Water Resources Act 2007 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 28(1) (current republication (R29, from 26 November 2025; Water Resources Act 2007 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person must not take water from a place if the person does not have a licence to take the water from the place

administration.note: The Water Resources Act 2007 calls it 'the authority'; its note to s 69 points to the Environment Protection Act 1997, s 14(2).

sources.title: Water Resources Act 2007 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 4, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current republication (R29, from 26 November 2025; Water Resources Act 2007 | Acts)
sources.quote: The authority must not approve the transfer of a water access entitlement unless satisfied that— (a) the intended use of the water and the place it is proposed to be used is— (i) consistent with the conditions of the entitlement;

reach.condition: if it takes water from a regulated river, aquifer or other water source, beyond basic landholder rights
